result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a loading indicator appears to be stuck over an already visible restaurant image.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a large loading spinner overlay centered on the image, even though the image and restaurant details are visible. This makes the card look partially stuck in a loading state and visually obstructs the content.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading spinner once the image/card content has loaded, or show a clear placeholder only while the image is actually loading.
